_meta.question: Is the sound of {} present in this recording? Answer yes or no.
_meta.score: max logit over yes ids - max logit over no ids
_meta.audio: data/work/devcand/wav16/<clip>.wav (ffmpeg of the mp4, 16 kHz mono), [cut_start - 1, cut_end + 1] s clipped to the clip, at least 1 s
_meta.P2: FlexSED query runs >= 0.4, gaps <= 0.24 s merged, any length, not covered by same-family P1 (canonical family, overlap > 0); runs < 1 s cut as 1 s centred on the peak frame
_meta.P3: BEATs label runs >= 0.175 with peak < 0.35, not covered by same-family P1; identical family spans deduped
_meta.gold: score_per_sound.score_clip on the span as a lone picture: hit -> hit_needed, phantom -> none, else other_gold
_meta.null: vocab family not the family of any gold sound of the clip (random.Random(0))
